issues.issue: Water, Sewer and Garbage Fund 'Local Receipts: Other' (receipts[9]-[11]) are assumed to be utility collections; the report prints no breakdown. Defensible, since these are the utility funds' only own receipts, and review notes are present.
The extractor added fund names in parentheses to the printed labels (also receipts[10], receipts[11], disbursements[6], disbursements[7]). Printed text kept otherwise.

Category capital outlay is correct, but the 2026-10-28 rule relabels capital outlay lines as 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (printed text in printed_label). Not applied to disbursements[2] or [3]. The function can be inferred from the fund (Street Fund means streets/highways; General Fund means general government).
